_comment: The required of each SnapRealms field, derived from the model (every view join is LEFT OUTER). A joined dimension is required only when its @of field is required and every hop is a belongs-to reference over a required, enforced foreign key onto a target that hides no rows (not a TPH subtype). Read by TypeScript (metadata/test/report-required-conformance.test.ts) C# (ReportShapeTests), Java (ReportShapeTest) and Python (test_report_shape.py).
